svg.text: spectUI is the only reader of configuration · spectHR is pure compute · arrows show data / config flow
algorithm · bands: Dict[str, BandSpec] · alpha_ci · mean_convention
welch: WelchOptions lombscargle: LombscargleOptions carspan: CarspanOptions
phases: INH/EXH interval list per band
PSDResult: freqs · power · ci_lower · ci_upper · unit · method
TransferResult / TransferProfileResult: freqs · modulus · phase · coherence · band summaries
time_metrics: count mean median rmssd sdnn sdsd sd1 sd2 pnn50 …
freq_metrics: fullrange vlf_power lf_power hf_power lf_hf_ratio
bp_metrics: bp_sbp bp_dbp bp_pp bp_map resp_mvo resp_svo rsa rsa0
per-epoch cache: HRV metrics · PSD · band powers · transfer · profile · RSA · BP → feeds export
full arrays · HDF5 groups per epoch
spectUI — workspace I/O · configuration · plot widgets · export
File loading — loaders (XDF, NFF, CSV, PKL) · PreProcessFile
spectHR · DataSet — PhysioData · CardioSeries · RespirationSeries · TimeSeries · Epoch
spectHR · Analysis — PSD backends · Transfer · Profiles · Metrics · RSA · EpochContext
Export — CSV (scalar metrics per epoch) + HDF5 (full arrays)
Dependency rule: spectUI imports from spectHR · spectHR has zero module-level configuration state.
All knobs travel as parameters; PsdMethod is the single named bundle the UI hands across the boundary.
